Name: Laser Cannon
Author: TacNotCat
Description:
Laser Cannon
Charge 1 second then fire a continuous beam. Four ammo types boost damage and beam width. Six stat upgrades, 8 ascension stages, forge enchantable. Win it via Qi's Skull Cavern 200 challenge.
[heading]Installation[/heading]
[list=1]
[*]Install SMAPI 4.0.0+[/*]
[*]Extract the mod folder into your Stardew Valley/Mods directory[/*]
[*]Launch the game via SMAPI[/*]
[/list][heading]Main features[/heading]
[list]
[*]Charge 1s then fire a continuous piercing beam[/*]
[*]4 ammo types boost damage & beam width[/*]
[*]6 stat upgrades (damage, width, speed, duration, ammo capacity, recharge)[/*]
[*]8 ascension stages with visual changes[/*]
[*]Forge enchantable at the volcano forge[/*]
[*]Secret debug sticker: tap 3 times to max all upgrades, long-press 5s to reset all[/*]
[*]Obtained by completing Qi's Skull Cavern 200 challenge[/*]
[/list][heading]Requirements[/heading]
[list]
[*]SMAPI 4.0.0 or later[/*]
[/list][heading]⚠ Multiplayer warning ⚠[/heading]
Not recommended for multiplayer. Due to the mod author's technical limitations, multiplayer compatibility of the laser cannon is not guaranteed.

Manifest.Name: Laser Cannon
Manifest.Description: Adds the Laser Cannon: charge for 1 second, then fire a continuous beam. Four ammo types (iridium bar, prismatic shard, radioactive ore, Galaxy Soul) add damage and beam width. Upgrade six stats and unlock eight stages in Mr. Qi's menu, enchant it at the forge, and earn it by completing Qi's Skull Cavern 200 challenge. Single-player only.
Manifest.Author: TacNotCat
